t: The Life of a New York City Noise Sensor Network
s: March 22, 2019 - At the Sounds Of New York City or SONYC project, we have deployed a network of over 55 low-cost acoustic sensor nodes across NYC to facilitate the continuous, real-time, accurate and source-specific monitoring of urban noise [6]. This enables large-scale analysis of urban noise activity including predictive noise impact models and interactive 3D visualizations to reveal noise patterns across space and time.
